thread:
emily: morning! day 1. need access to Console Env Panel — qa admin for onboarding checks, prod readonly to view runbooks. who do i ping?
rajan: welcome emily :wave: open infra-permissions and paste manager approval. infra prefers a short ticket; they can do QA admin same day usually.
emily: can you paste the exact fields to include?
rajan: sure, copy this:
```
Title: Env Panel access: emily
Requester: emily
Manager: <manager-name>
Environments: qa (admin), prod (readonly)
Flags to touch: onboarding.*
Duration: 14 days
Purpose: onboarding validation + runbook walkthrough
```
emily: filed INF-5123 and added manager approval. tagged @rajan.
access-bot: verification tips: once infra updates, check Console -> avatar -> "My permissions" OR run: `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.internal/api/v1/me/roles | jq` You should see `"env_panel": "admin"` for qa and `"env_panel": "readonly"` for prod. If prod remains viewer, it may be awaiting SCIM group sync.
rajan: noted. if infra asks for rollout ids before granting prod viewer, provide the list or ask for group membership instead.
emily: infra marked QA admin done, prod pending. will wait on SCIM sync. thanks!
